attempt_allocation_scope.reason: this kernel holds each committed Phase 2A attempt count and side split fixed; it contains no attempt-allocation mechanism

limits: This is a count-level diagnostic and does not replay or alter the Phase 2A simulator.
Beta-Binomial moment parameters are fitted to the 16 committed model draws, not to actual game SOG labels.
A floor is claimed achieved only when both the preregistered dispersion band and the sigma-zero CRPS interval criterion pass.
Condition B and any joint rule conclusion are out of scope because this kernel has no attempt-allocation layer.

model_fit.fallback: Binomial when observed sample variance is at or below the method-of-moments binomial-plus-attempt variance, or no second factorial attempt moment exists
model_fit.mean_rate: sum of the 16 SOG counts / sum of the 16 attempt counts
model_fit.method: one Beta-Binomial per eligible game-side, method of moments from the 16 Phase 2A SOG counts and their fixed, varying attempt counts
model_fit.variance_estimator: ddof=1 ensemble sample variance; binomial and attempt-mean variation are removed before estimating Beta probability variance

protocol.bootstrap_unit: eligible game ID; both teams and all 16 draws stay together
protocol.common_random_numbers: same per-game-draw normal and per-side inverse-CDF uniforms at every sigma within a replicate
protocol.condition_a_raw: per-replicate mean paired team-SOG CRPS delta versus Phase 2A <= 0
protocol.crps: vectorized exact discrete empirical-ensemble CRPS; parity-tested against the previously cross-checked feasibility helper
protocol.floor_achievement_rule: mean sigma-zero dispersion ratio is in [0.98, 1.02] AND its paired 95% game-cluster CRPS interval contains zero
protocol.floor_adjusted_delta: same-replicate, same-game candidate CRPS minus sigma-zero candidate CRPS; report as diagnostic sensitivity, not a changed preregistered gate
protocol.sog_eligibility: fit and score only the 1,292 games with accepted official team SOG

floor_adjusted_sog_crps.definition: paired per-game candidate CRPS minus the same replicate's sigma-zero CRPS
